caption: The drawing depicts a gold-colored sculptural object resembling a bird, specifically a rooster, standing upright on top of a golden spherical base. The rooster features detailed feather patterns engraved along its body, wings, and tail. Its beak is closed, and the eyes are clearly defined. The wings are partially raised and curve backward, with deeply etched feathers. The claws of the bird grip the spherical object firmly, and the whole structure is mounted on a rectangular wooden platform with a lighter wood tone. There are no additional objects or background elements, and the composition is centralized on a plain, light beige backdrop.
title: Golden Eagle Gatepost
